title: Contact
heading: The conversation continues.
description: Contact Viking Legacy & Lore with episode ideas, corrections, resource suggestions or collaboration enquiries at vikinglegacyandlore@gmail.com.
intro: Questions, episode ideas, reading recommendations and thoughtful corrections are welcome.

sections.heading: Write to the show
paragraphs: The email link below opens your email application. You can also copy the address into your preferred email service.

sections.heading: Make your message easy to follow
paragraphs: For an episode question or correction, include the title, relevant timestamp or passage, and a supporting source where possible. For a resource suggestion, include the title, author or institution and a link.

sections.heading: Ideas for the written publication
paragraphs: Planning to suggest a future article? The Contribute page explains what to include in a short pitch.
